content: Python statistics module: median() returns low median (sorted middle value; for even N returns smaller of two middle values), raises StatisticsError on empty input. stdev() computes SAMPLE stdev (divides by N-1), raises StatisticsError if fewer than 2 data points (needs at least 2 points to estimate dispersion). pstdev() computes POPULATION stdev (divides by N), also needs at least 1 point but is stable at N=1 (returns 0.0).
